name: CofiBit (5-EMA channel + fast stoch cross)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
indicators: STOCHF(5,3,0,3,0), EMA(5) of high/close/low, ADX(14); buy_fastx=25, buy_adx=25, sell_fastx=75
entry_long: open<EMA5(low) AND fastk crosses above fastd AND fastk<25 AND fastd<25 AND ADX>25
exit: open>=EMA5(high) OR fastk crosses above 75 OR fastd crosses above 75
implementation_notes: Also base of Scalp/SmoothScalp. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
